title: Scream
paragraphs: “W-What on earth…?”
“I’ll explain in detail later. But to be brief, I’ve experienced all of this before, Father.”
“Father?”
Ah, I can finally call him that comfortably.
“Didn’t Motoyasu-san just say that? He said he’d explain later.”
“Ah, that’s right… If I had to put it another way, Motoyasu knows everything about the game. Naofumi, he wants to help you.”
“Haah… Alright, for now. I understand.”
Father seems to be postponing the matter for now. Then, with tears in his eyes, Father nodded.
“I see… I thought it was strange how Motoyasu-kun’s eyes seemed more sympathetic than accusatory toward me. So, it was all an act.”
“It was necessary to draw out the enemy.”
“Naofumi didn’t do it. He was just sleeping.”
“Naofumi-san is innocent. We guarantee it. We also believe that this chainmail was stolen.”
“Yeah… yeah. Thank you.”

I’ve seen it before, but Father’s face is a mess, overflowing with tears. His feelings of relief at being believed are palpable. These events will serve as a lesson, making Father even kinder. Even Ren and Itsuki seem a little embarrassed.
“Bubububu! Bubuhibububu!?”
The Crimson Swine started making a ruckus. What an incredibly ugly crying face. Compared to Father, it’s like heaven and earth. How utterly fake.

The difference between someone pleading their innocence and a liar is this vast. Even if the false tears are convincing, they’re meaningless before those of us who know the truth. Ren and Itsuki seem to have fully grasped the difference.
“Such shallow tears. Naofumi-san’s words resonate much deeper.”
“That’s right. Don’t think your lies will fool us.”
“If Motoyasu-san hadn’t warned us, I shudder to think that we might have believed you.”
“They say beautiful flowers are often poisonous… but this is a deadly toxin. And to think you enjoy watching others suffer makes it even worse.”
“After hearing that, I also paid close attention. I saw you secretly provoking Naofumi-san.”
Oh? Did Itsuki notice? How did he manage that? As I wondered, he pointed to the soldiers restraining Father.
“It was a reflex. I spotted it while carefully observing.”
“Impressive.”

Itsuki has precision abilities, so his eyesight must be excellent. If he was looking carefully, it’s no surprise he saw it. Eventually, Ren and Itsuki took up their weapons. Since I wasn’t stalking them this time, their levels should be a bit higher. Well, no matter how many enemies appear, neither Ren nor Itsuki will get hurt with me around.

“Amaki-dono, Kawasumi-dono, Kitamura-dono, what is the meaning of this? Do you intend to defend the Shield Hero, who attempted to violate his companion? Even if you are fellow otherworlders, this is not something that should be forgiven.”
“You’re the acting king, right? You still have time. If you apologize sincerely, I might let this slide.”
“That’s right. Continuing this farce is just adding to your shame. Give it up.”
Trash stood up, trying to hide his frustration as he attempted to explain himself.
“Amaki-dono, Kawasumi-dono, Kitamura-dono! Don’t be swayed by fleeting emotions! You can’t save the world by trusting such an ingrate!”
“Ingrate? How laughable. You summoned us, and the moment an inconvenient Hero was called, you pinned a false crime on him to punish him.”
“Hmph, you think I don’t know? I know the truth. This country views the Shield Hero as an enemy of their religion.”
“An enemy of their religion!?”
Father looked at me in surprise. I nodded.
“The Shield Hero is an inconvenient existence for this Melromarc.”
Father nodded repeatedly in stunned understanding.
“I see… So that’s why those unnatural stares… And this conspiracy…”
“If they had killed Father secretly right after the summoning, we would have been suspicious. With the status of a Hero, such an act would draw condemnation from other nations.”
“There’s no saving them. Just give it up. Such schemes won’t work in front of the Heroes!”
“If they had just kept him under tight protection, he wouldn’t have been able to escape. I’m speechless.”
Ren coldly cut Trash down with his words.
“Anyway, enough of this farce. We’re not going to be your puppets.”
“That’s right. We’ve seen your evil with our own eyes. It’s time to change your ways!”
Itsuki firmly pointed at Trash, declaring it. His words were slightly different from the previous time. That’s because they know the Queen will arrive to deliver judgment.
“Buhi!”
The Crimson Swine stopped her fake crying and spat out something. Just like last time, she revealed her true colors. I’ve been given permission to kill her this time. When should I do it?
“Grrr…” Trash groaned in frustration.
Now, will you give up? Of course not. I can’t wait to see the expression on your face in just a moment.
“You should’ve just done as we wished… Enough of this!”
As expected, Trash stood up and declared loudly.
“Men! Kill these fake heroes immediately!”
“Buhii! Buhibuhii!”

Crimson Swine, your death is inevitable. I’ve used you to gain Father’s trust. That’s more than enough. But if I kill her here, the Queen might scold me. Then again, considering it’s her daughter’s mess, she might forgive me. Ah, that reminds me, there was something I’ve always wanted to try. If I kill the Crimson Swine here, Trash will probably get loud and ignore the Queen’s restraint. It’s probably best to avoid that.
“No matter. We’ll just perform the next Hero summoning ritual. This time, we’ll summon the real heroes!”
“If that’s the order, then it can’t be helped.”
Ren and Itsuki’s comrades drew their weapons and pointed them at us. Ren and Itsuki exchanged looks, half-exasperated. More soldiers gathered, surrounding us.
“…Everything is going exactly as Motoyasu-san predicted.”
“Yeah. It’s almost like it was scripted.”
This is nothing but a farce. Queen, it’s about time. That’s what I thought, but… she’s still not here.
“Motoyasu-san.”
Itsuki looked at me with concern.
“Isn’t she supposed to be coming?”
“There’s no way we’re missing just that part, right?”
“W-What’s going on?”

Something’s not right. The Queen should be arriving soon. As I focused on the surroundings, I sensed magical energy outside the room. I also thought I could hear the distant sound of fighting. Could it be that something is delaying the Queen’s arrival?
“Buhihihihii! Bububu!”
“Yes! Low-level fake heroes are no better than babies!”
Trash declared that, and then a shadow appeared beside him. It whispered in his ear.
“Hmph. Mirellia is engaged in diplomacy far away. It’s just a body double trying to abuse her authority. Capture them quickly!”

Oh, the commotion outside must be the Queen. It seems they were trying to catch her in the act but were stopped. The interference is undoubtedly from the Three Heroes Church. This situation is beyond what both Father and the Queen anticipated.
“Looks like Motoyasu-san was right.”
“Yeah, I’m certain after hearing that name.”
“W-What do you mean? Is everything okay?”
“It’s fine. If I wanted to, I could kill everyone here in an instant.”
“Hey, that’s a bit of an exaggeration,” Ren said, looking exasperated.
It’s not an exaggeration.
“We should buy some time until the Queen arrives—”
Before Itsuki could even finish suggesting that, Trash spoke.
“If you kill the Shield with your own hands, I might still forgive you.”
“Shut up! I’d rather die here than be used by the likes of you!”
“I agree with Ren-san. I have no desire to fight for those who discriminate while the world is heading toward destruction.”
It seems we have no choice but to go to the Queen now. To think they’d go so far as to call the Queen a fake and interfere… how absurd.
“Very well then. Let’s go. You fools will learn firsthand the folly of opposing the heroes!”
“Ren, Itsuki, Motoyasu… thank you…”
In that moment when Father and I exchanged glances—
“Gotcha! Dieeeeeeeeeee!”
Smoked Meat charged at us. It’s such a hassle being told not to kill him for the sake of negotiations.
“Aiming Lancer! Brionac!”
I raised my spear high—though I had to adjust since we were indoors—and incapacitated Smoked Meat first. I’ll make him atone for the false accusations against Father.
“Guaaaaaaaaaaaah!?”
“Uwaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!?”
“W-Why…? I thought… they were low-level…”
“S-So this is… the strength of otherworlders…”
“It hurts… Ugh… Help me…”
The soldiers all muttered their dying words. Don’t make such a fuss when I’m only attacking to incapacitate. This is annoying. Should I just finish them all off one by one?
“Die! Fake hero! Haaaaaaaaaah!”

Oh? The Smoked Meat got back up and charged at me again. Surprisingly tough. Last time, it was a skilled knight, but this time it’s just Smoked Meat. I was too focused on the knight before and didn’t pay enough attention to him.
“Too slow.”
Last time, I impaled him through the chest to finish him off, but I need to hold back this time. Let’s aim for the stomach instead. I’ll pierce a spot that won’t kill him.
“Guh!?”
The Smoked Meat stared in disbelief at his own impaled abdomen. And then—
“Gyaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!”
A piercing scream echoed. How noisy. It’s making me want to finish him off. The previous knight died in stunned silence, but this guy… he’s ridiculously tenacious.
“I-It huuuuuuuurts! I’m gonna die, I’m gonna die, I’m gonna diiiiiiie! H-Help meeeeeeeee!”

You’ve just been stabbed. The pain should be numbed by now. This is just your brain tricking you. Well, Smoked Meat always struck me as the type to be ruled by his eyes, so this is to be expected. This is what you were planning to do to us, isn’t it? No… You were trying to kill us. What I’m doing is far kinder.
“Eek!?”
Ren, Itsuki, and Father raised their voices at the sight of the screaming Smoked Meat. I guess they were startled by how loud he was.
“H-He was trying to kill us… so, i-it can’t be helped, right?”
“Y-Yeah. You have to fend off the sparks before they burn you… This is what battle is. And when your opponent is human, of course there’s… going to be blood…”
“Ah… ahh…”
“He’s not dead yet, you know? I was told not to kill him.”
In fact, everyone around is just incapacitated. Though Smoked Meat is being a bit too noisy.
“Be quiet already. Enough of this.”

I swung my spear, shaking off Smoked Meat, and pierced him with Paralyze Lance before he could fly away. The Smoked Meat, thrown against the wall, was paralyzed and didn’t move a muscle. This should quiet things down a bit.
“Now then…”

As always, the Crimson Swine and Trash are good at avoiding attacks. They seem to be using the knights as shields, so they’re unharmed. Just as the Crimson Swine skillfully tried to escape and leave the throne room, the door swung open, and the Queen appeared, accompanied by Shadow.
“Where do you think you’re running off to, Malty?”
“Buh!?”
The Crimson Swine let out a shocked noise. Trash was the same… no, he still had a hint of composure.
“That’s an imposter! Shadow, capture that traitor impersonating the Queen! And kill the fake heroes!”
He seemed to be smiling with the confidence of unexpected reinforcements, but mere shadows cannot stop me now.
“Who are you calling a fake?”
The Queen’s anger seemed to lower the temperature in the room.
“Well then, Aultcray, whether I’m real or not… why don’t you experience it firsthand?”
‘Root of power, as commanded by the Queen—’
“W-What!? That chant… no way—”
Trash stared at the Queen in disbelief. The others were also groaning, their eyes widening in shock.
‘Decode the truth once more and bind them with ice.’
“Drifa Icicle Prison!”
With the Queen’s spell, Trash and the Crimson Swine were captured. They were frozen up to their heads, left only able to speak.
“Honestly… how much more foolish can you become? Everyone! I declare this now—stop fighting immediately!”
The Queen clapped her hands, and all the soldiers who had rushed in, along with the groaning fools, lost their will to fight.
“Bububuh!? Bububu!”
“Impossible! Why is Mirellia here!? She was supposed to be away on a diplomatic mission!”
“With the power of Kitamura-sama, the Spear Hero, she was able to instantly travel across great distances.”
“W-What!?”
Trash glared at me. I gave him a mocking middle finger in response. Then, the Queen stood before Trash and slapped his cheek with a loud paaan.
“Guh!”

“Not only did you summon the Four Holy Heroes without permission, but you also schemed to falsely accuse the Shield Hero! I am beyond words! Are you truly thinking about the good of the kingdom? It’s time you broadened your horizons!”
Then, she punched the Crimson Swine, who was squealing excuses.
“Malty, everyone here understands that you’re the one in the wrong. Give up already.”
“Buhii! Buhibuhibuhii!”
“I didn’t do anything!”
“Of course, Naofumi-san didn’t do anything.”
“Yeah, there’s no doubt.”

The Crimson Swine ignored Father and the others, continuing to squeal and cry fake tears at the Queen. What is she even saying? Father doesn’t have the energy to explain right now. Ah, I forgot to mention that I can’t understand pig language.
“Does that change anything?”
“Buh!? Buhbubububuhibuufufufuhii! Bubububu!”
“You weren’t a virgin to begin with, were you? Did you think I wouldn’t know? I see no difference between you and a common whore.”
“A daughter viewed that way by her own parent… how pitiful.”
“Malty would never do such a thing! Mirellia! You need to change your—mmph!”
Trash was smacked by the Queen’s fan.
“Aultcray. It’s time you gave up your delusions about Malty. She’s beyond saving.”
“Buhii!”
“Stop pretending to care about Aultcray’s feelings. It’s nauseating.”
Then, she slapped the Crimson Swine again.
“Bububububu!”

“Did you think I wouldn’t know? How arrogant. If you had truly been involved with Iwatani-sama, the Shield Hero, there might have been a sliver of hope for you… If only you had stayed loyal to him, I might have given you some credit.”
“She’s really going for it now.”
“Please, stop!”
Father shouted. There’s no chance of repairing this relationship anymore.
“Bububu!”
“Did Iwatani-sama truly… while drunk?”
The Crimson Swine nodded repeatedly. Impossible. The Queen let out a deep sigh.
“Melty.”
“Yes.”
“Testify to everything you’ve seen.”
“Yes, Mother… after Mother left with the heroes, the Shield Hero remained asleep the entire time. There’s no mistake.”
“Bububububuhii!? Bububu!”
The Crimson Swine was making a fuss, as if insulting Fiancé. She was probably claiming that Melty was lying to slander her.

“Melty would never do such a thing, unlike you. I saw it myself. I watched as you snuck into Iwatani-sama’s room while he was asleep, stole anything of value—money, clothes, and even chainmail—and as you left, you laughed and said, ‘Fufufu… what a foolish man, so easily deceived… I can’t wait for tomorrow.’”
“Bubububuhii!?”
The Crimson Swine interrupted with a shocked cry.
“How, you ask? Because I was watching your crime unfold from the attic. I’ve been looking forward to this day—when I could finally scold you like this.”
